business_summary: Great China Holdings (Hong Kong) Limited, an investment holding company, engages in property development and investment business in the People's Republic of China. The company offers hotel management, financial consultancy, trust management, trading, department stores, and ports and logistics services. It also operates a resort. The company was formerly known as Great China Properties Holdings Limited and changed its name to Great China Holdings (Hong Kong) Limited in July 2022. Great China Holdings (Hong Kong) Limited was incorporated in 1954 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Great China Holdings (Hong Kong) Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 부동산 개발 및 투자 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 호텔 경영, 금융 컨설팅, 신탁 관리, 무역, 백화점, 항만 및 물류 서비스를 제공하는 회사입니다. 리조트도 운영하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Great China Properties Holdings Limited로 알려졌으며 2022년 7월에 Great China Holdings (Hong Kong) Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Great China Holdings (Hong Kong) Limited는 1954년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
